scope: PROPOSED TARGETS; not baseline measurements or promises; measure on native Windows and record hardware

profiles.minimum_target: Windows 10/11 x64; 1280x720; system with pygame-ce bundled; hardware to be recorded, not assumed
profiles.reference_target: Windows 11 x64; 1920x1080; desktop integrated GPU; record CPU/RAM/GPU specs

budgets.target: p95 <=16.7ms, p99 <=33.3ms at 1280x720 with VSync excluded
budgets.method: perf_counter_ns 120s for each world, after 20s warmup; collect 7200 frames or duration
budgets.failure: profile hotspots, particle cap, tile caching

budgets.target: warm steady state <=512MiB and slope <=1MiB/min over 20min exploration
budgets.method: psutil if present, otherwise Windows performance counters
budgets.failure: cache bounds, reference cycles, texture life

budgets.target: p95 <=150ms on local SSD for representative <=1MiB profile
budgets.method: 100 saves with temporary profiles; record cold cache
budgets.failure: bound event/replay buffers, avoid repeated save

budgets.metric: cold launcher until first interactive frame
budgets.target: <=8s reference machine; record slow hardware separately
budgets.method: Windows monotonic automated or video timestamp; 5 cold launches

budgets.target: <=3s execution timeout plus bounded process startup/cleanup; timeout must be surfaced
budgets.method: real grader timing and status; upper bound not claimed as UI latency
budgets.failure: future asynchronous submission while preserving process boundary

budgets.target: identical committed action sequence and final hash at 30, 60, 120 fps for same fixture

budgets.method: actual frame screenshot capture at 2+ map positions per world, plus automated bounding assertions
